response.sql: SELECT AVG(item_avg_ratio) AS average_item_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_item_count FROM (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(product_price / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS item_avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) AS per_item;

assumptions.assumption: A ratio is missing when either value is NULL or derived_total_cost is zero; its line item still counts.
